changelog: FIX (critical): In-app updater showed a misleading green checkmark with the words 'Opening installer…' that users were reading as 'DONE' — they'd tap Dismiss and never actually install the update. The updater now shows an amber warning icon, big 'ONE MORE STEP' headline, and an explicit 'Install Now' button you can tap if the Android prompt never appears.

FIX (critical): Some Fire OS builds silently dropped the install intent — no exception, no installer screen, user stranded. The updater now tries TWO different intent types (ACTION_VIEW first, ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE fallback) and surfaces a clear error message if both fail, so users know to install manually instead of thinking the app is broken.

INHERITED v1.44.136: Continue Watching now dispatches by content kind so series tiles no longer mis-resolve to VOD stream IDs. HushXXX subsystem code removed entirely + one-shot purge of any legacy adult-content Continue Watching entries.
INHERITED v1.44.132: Lite-mode boot refresh, main-looper resilience handler, tightened Coil mem cache.
